title: TAP SBOM trusted signers
description: The default-deny list of signer identities whose SBOM attestations TAP accepts (req-cicd-sbom-22-7). Validated at load; an unknown field, a missing pin without the transitional marker, or an empty list is a load failure.

format.description: Format discriminator; bump on breaking shape changes.

signers.description: The trusted identities. An empty list is invalid, not 'trust nothing': the loader fails so the run fails.

_description.description: What this signer is and why its pin looks the way it does.

id.description: Short stable name for logs and the SBOM node.

repository.description: owner/repo that holds the signing workflow file.

workflow_path.description: Path of the signing workflow file in that repository.

ref.description: The ref the certificate's signer identity names, matched exactly: a branch or tag ref, or a 40-hex commit when the signing workflow was called by commit (the certificate's signer identity then ends in that commit).

signer_digest.description: The commit of the signing workflow file (the certificate's Build Signer Digest), checked by `gh attestation verify --signer-digest`. Null is allowed only with transitional true.

transitional.description: True marks an entry that is not digest-pinned and is meant to be removed. Required to be true when signer_digest is null.

reason.description: Why this signer is trusted, and for a transitional entry when it goes away.

added_by.description: Who approved the entry and where.
